in 2007, an artist named Stelarc implanted a cell-cultivated ear containing and Internet capable microphone onto his left arm, which Internet users could listen into via a web interface. it took him ten years to raise the funds to grow the ear and find a team of plastic surgeons willing to perform the procedure. the ear is a permanent fixture and has its own tissue and blood supply. “This ear is not for me, I’ve got two good ears to hear with. This ear is a remote listening device for people in other places.”
